# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 4 tokens; Text — 3 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 3 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 16 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 13 tokens; Radius — 6 tokens; Shadow — 1 token; Font size — 11 tokens; Font weight — 4 tokens; Line height — 3 tokens; Letter spacing — 3 tokens; Blur — 4 tokens; Duration — 5 tokens; Easing — 3 tokens; Opacity — 1 token; Z index — 4 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, rgba(10,18,14,0.42));
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" or "solid" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from that theme’s column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface, rgba(250,248,243,0.58));   /* the light theme’s value */
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: rgba(10,18,14,0.42);
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | dark | light | solid | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | rgba(10,18,14,0.42) | rgba(250,248,243,0.58) | #1d2722 | Стекло: карточки, строка ввода, панели. Всегда вместе с размытием blur-glass и линией line-soft. |
| `--surface-strong` | rgba(14,22,18,0.84) | rgba(251,249,245,0.92) | #26322b | Плотное стекло: диалог, меню, всплывающее уведомление, мини-окно ввода поверх других программ. |
| `--surface-sunken` | rgba(245,239,228,0.07) | rgba(24,34,28,0.06) | rgba(245,239,228,0.05) | Утопленная подложка внутри стекла: поле ввода, шапка таблицы, дорожка прогресса, строка под курсором. |

**Interaction states** (same roles, suffixed):

| token | dark | light | solid |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface-hover` | rgba(10,18,14,0.54) | rgba(250,248,243,0.74) | #232e28 |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--text, #f5efe4);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" or "solid" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from that theme’s column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--text, #18221c);   /* the light theme’s value */
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f5efe4;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | dark | light | solid | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--text` | #f5efe4 | #18221c | #f5efe4 | Основной текст на surface, surface-strong и на вуали scrim-*. Не ниже 4.5:1 во всех темах. |
| `--text-muted` | #d4ccbf | #45514a | #d4ccbf | Вторичный текст: дата, пояснения, подписи карточек, подсказки. На surface, surface-strong и вуали — не ниже 4.5:1. |
| `--text-faint` | #a9a196 | #6c766f | #a9a196 | Только плейсхолдеры и недоступные элементы. Не для смыслового текста: на стекле около 3:1. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 200 128px/1 "Jost", "Futura", "Century Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-t-clock); letter-spacing: 0.02em;
font-family: var(--font-heading);   /* the family alone */
```

### Font files

Fonts: `tokens.css` loads each font from its file, by path.

- **Design canvas:** copy `fonts/Jost-Variable.woff2` and `fonts/Manrope-Variable.woff2` to the same paths under the canvas’s `project/ds/<folder>/` (`<folder>` is the folder you install this system under; `fonts/Jost-Variable.woff2` lands on `project/ds/<folder>/fonts/Jost-Variable.woff2`), in the same call that installs this system; the copy of `tokens.css` that each artboard links loads them from there. If the install’s reply leaves a font out, bring that font in as for any other page.
- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.
- **Any other page:** one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`), upload it as an asset (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `faces` key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Jost | `fonts/Jost-Variable.woff2` (weight 100 900) | `read fonts/Jost-Variable.woff2` | `var(--font-heading)` | `jost` |
| Manrope | `fonts/Manrope-Variable.woff2` (weight 200 800) | `read fonts/Manrope-Variable.woff2` | `var(--font-body)` | `manrope` |

## Spacing

Шаг 4px. Высоты элементов управления — тоже здесь.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (13)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Зазор значка и текста в теге, между строками подписи. |

| `--space-3` | 12px | Внутренний отступ поля по бокам; между строками плана. |

| `--space-5` | 20px | Отступ карточки по бокам; поля экрана на телефоне. |

## Duration

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--duration-fast: 120ms) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--duration-fast), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--duration-fast` | 120ms | Наведение, нажатие, смена цвета рамки. |
| `--duration-base` | 220ms | Появление меню, уведомления, переключатель, вкладки. |
| `--duration-slow` | 450ms | Появление поля пароля, перенос элемента корзины. |
| `--duration-scene` | 800ms | Смена сцены: заставка → пароль → «Сегодня», размытие фото. |
| `--duration-breathe` | 4000ms | «Дыхание» подсказки на заставке. Отключается при «уменьшить движение». |

## Easing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1)) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--ease-out), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--ease-out` | cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1) | Появление и всё по умолчанию: быстро начинается, мягко садится. |
| `--ease-in-out` | cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.25, 1) | Переходы между двумя состояниями (переключатель, вкладки). |
| `--ease-in` | cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1) | Уход элемента: закрытие, улёт в корзину. |
